snippet.title: Echoes of Aromia - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Set 20 years after a world war, known as the Clockwork Revolution, this medieval fantasy world now finds itself on the brink of industrialization. Experience how the world rebuilds itself on the ashes of the Clockwork Army’s failure. Explore the cities and landscapes of Aromia. Uncover lost lore, help those in need, and shape the future of a world healing from its past.

Echoes of Aromia is a solo passion project, based off of a story over 10 years in writting, now brought into the form of an open world turnbased pixel art RPG.

Wishlist Echoes of Aromia on Steam!
